atoms.sound: ssml: Listen and watch carefully.<break time='300ms'/>
atoms.text: Is your sound on? Listen and watch first.

atoms.sound: ssml: <break time='500ms'/> Let’s read the clock. <break time='300ms'/> We will start with the full hours. <break time='400ms'/>
ssml: Whenever the minute hand points upwards to 12, a full hour has passed.<break time='400ms'/>

instruction.sound: Now it’s your turn: What number does the minute hand point to when a full hour has passed? Select it.
instruction.text: What number does the <m-blue>minute hand</m-blue> point to when an hour has passed?

atoms.sound: ssml: And do you already know what the hour hand does? <break time='200ms'/>
ssml: <break time='300ms'/>The hour hand shows us which full hour it is.<break time='500ms'/>

instruction.sound: What number does the hour hand point to? Select the number.
instruction.text: What number does the <m-red>hour hand</m-red> point to?

atoms.sound: ssml: <break time='200ms'/> On this clock, the minute hand points upwards, to twelve. <break time='100ms'/> And the hour hand points to 4.<break time='300ms'/> So it is 4 o’clock. <break time='500ms'/>

instruction.sound: Now it’s your turn again. On which of these clocks is it 2 o’clock?
Now select the clock that says 6 o’clock.
And where does it show 10 o’clock?

trainers.finishSound: Done! You read the clocks correctly.

instruction.sound: And again: Which clock shows 3 o’clock?
Select the clock that shows 1 o’clock.
And again: On which clock is it 12 o’clock?
One last time: Which clock shows 7 o’clock?
